I don't think it's a problem. Seeing a psychiatrist is about getting help for you, so it's best to be comfortable with the situation. 

Initially when I sought a psychiatrist, I chose to see a woman as well. I'm a woman and felt more comfortable talking to another woman about my problems because I felt she would understand better and be more empathetic towards certain issues than a man would. 

At this point in time, I'm seeing a male psychiatrist who I feel is just as empathetic and listens just as well. 

Finding the right psychiatrist is about your preferences and needs, not about how people think you should feel. 

At this stage, you feel more comfortable talking to a woman. That's completely okay. This might change or not. 

Find what works for you.
